# The Aga Khan University

> A global institution of higher education and healthcare spanning Pakistan, East Africa, and the UK, offering programs in medicine, nursing, midwifery, and educational development.

The Aga Khan University (AKU) operates multiple campuses across South Asia and East Africa, providing comprehensive academic programs, clinical services through its hospital network, and research opportunities. The institution serves as both an educational leader and healthcare provider with a commitment to advancing health and knowledge in underserved regions.

## Key Topics

- Aga Khan University
- Medical College
- School of Nursing and Midwifery
- Pakistan campus
- East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda)
- AKU Arusha
- Institute for Educational Development
- Aga Khan University Hospital
- Graduate programs
- International education
- Healthcare services
- Research and innovation
- Nursing and midwifery education
- Multi-campus operations
- Aga Khan Development Network
